description: From an x402 402 response (its PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, base64, or the decoded JSON; a v1 body works too) and the payer: the EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization to sign and the payment to send back (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for v2, X-PAYMENT for v1), for USDG on Robinhood Chain. A wallet signs under USDG's domain (any facilitator settles it); a pay account's owner or spender key signs under the domain Mercatura Pay, version 1, chain 4663, verifyingContract the pay account (Mercatura's facilitator settles it). kind says which; left out, the factory is asked. Sign on your own machine: this tool never sees a key.

accept.description: Optional: the index in accepts to pay; the first USDG option on Robinhood Chain when left out.

payer.description: The address that pays: the wallet, or the pay account.

paymentRequired.description: The 402's PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64) or its decoded JSON.

name: x402_payment_typed_data
title: x402: the typed data that pays a 402
